title: PermissionError in pdf.export when sending a scheduled report
body:
## Environment

Lattice version 3.2.4; operating system Debian 12; server region eu-west-2.

## Steps

How to trigger it:
- Open Lattice and begin sending a scheduled report.
- Start the application as the service account.
- Watch the log for the traceback below.

## Expected

As on every earlier run, sending a scheduled report should just complete.

## Actual

Permission is refused on a file created by the app. The service account that
runs the app does not own that directory.

## Frequency

It occurs once a day or so.
stacktrace:
lattice/ui/main.py:45 in loop
lattice/report/schedule.py:69 in run_due
lattice/report/builder.py:138 in build
lattice/report/pdf.py:50 in export
PermissionError: [Errno 13] Permission denied: 'exports/2026-02.pdf'
